policies.purpose: Compare the scientific identity of generated TolTECA bindings without requiring projects to occupy the same filesystem location.

rules.rationale: TolTECA selects the calibration artifact; its filename is the portable identity while its project-root prefix is deployment-specific.
TolTECA selects each raw or generated input artifact; its filename is the portable identity while its project-root prefix is deployment-specific.
Native TolPROJ layouts have different directory depth, but the KIDs fit-report binding must continue to select the shared data directory.
The output root necessarily changes with the native project location; presence is required but the location is not scientific configuration.
The Beammap prior artifact name is configuration identity while its installed site prefix is deployment-specific.
